about.text: This is an appeal from the dismissal of a complaint under Rule 12(b)(6). As relevant here, Peter Strickland brought a claim under § 11(b) of the Voting Rights Act, 52 U.S.C. § 10307(b), against Stephen Jessup, who was at the time the Sheriff of McIntosh County in Georgia.

caseName: Timothy Gardner, et al v. Stephen Jessup
